full_prompt_en: A square hand-colored pen-and-ink illustration shows a top-hatted gentleman pausing in an old street as a crowd gathers around him, against pale stone and gray-blue shadow. The background is a lightly washed wall with fine vertical marks and a dark doorway on the left. A small framed notice occupies the high right corner, though its writing is too slight to read. Across the left half, men and women in varied hats and long garments cluster near the doorway, their faces sketched with quick expressive lines. A woman in a rose-colored dress stands out near the front of this group, her pale skirt widening across the lower left. At the center, the tall man wears a bronze-toned high hat, a deep teal coat, light waistcoat, and gray trousers. He stands with one leg crossed casually in front of the other and his hands held behind his back. His side-facing head and long white side whiskers are defined by brisk dark strokes rather than smooth modeling. At the right, an older seated man in a muted olive coat turns toward him, while a second seated figure bends over a paper or small object. A shaggy brown dog sits at their feet near the lower right edge. Broken marks across the cobbled ground indicate scattered debris and uneven surface texture. The light is broad and diffuse, leaving little solid cast shadow; pale washes describe volume, while dark hatch marks give faces, clothing folds, and the doorway their weight. Colored accents remain thin and transparent above the lively drawing. The overall composition balances the upright central figure against a busy crowd and quieter seated group, producing a humorous, observant street scene in restrained old-paper colors.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手工设色钢笔墨线插画呈现一位戴高礼帽的绅士在旧街上停步，周围人群聚集，背景是浅色石墙与灰蓝色阴影。后景是一面带细密竖向线痕的淡彩墙壁，左侧有深色门洞。右上角有一块小告示牌，但上面的文字太轻细，无法辨认。画面左半部，戴着不同帽子、穿长衣的人们挤在门洞附近，面孔以迅速而富于表情的线条勾出。一位玫瑰色长裙的女子站在这组人前方，浅色裙摆在左下角展开。中央的高个男子戴古铜色高帽，穿深青绿色外套、浅色马甲和灰色长裤。他把一条腿随意交叠在另一条腿前，双手背在身后。侧向的头部和长长白色鬓须以利落深色笔触界定，而非平滑塑形。右侧一位穿低饱和橄榄色外套的年长男子坐着转向他，旁边另一位坐着的人俯身看纸张或小物。两人脚边、靠近右下边缘坐着一只蓬毛棕狗。石铺地面的破碎笔痕表现散落碎物与起伏表面。光线宽泛而漫射，几乎没有结实的投影；浅色晕染描绘体积，深色排线则赋予面孔、衣褶与门洞重量。彩色重音薄而透明地覆盖在活泼的线描之上。整体构图用挺立的中央人物平衡左侧热闹人群与右侧较安静的坐者，形成以克制旧纸色调呈现的幽默观察式街景。
style_prompt_en: The hand-colored pen-and-ink technique keeps quick contour drawing visible beneath thin, irregular washes. Fine hatching and broken directional marks gather where forms turn into shadow, while lightly tinted open areas retain the warm breath of paper. Color is restrained but varied: dusty rose, muted teal, olive, warm gray, and cream sit above a predominantly black and brown line structure. Different degrees of line density create depth more than smooth tonal blending does. The arrangement favors lively clusters of small marks around a clearer vertical center, so complexity reads as social energy rather than undifferentiated noise. Edges remain slightly ragged and elastic, and gestures are caught with economical strokes. Broad diffuse illumination leaves washes transparent and lets the darkest accents anchor the composition. The overall effect is witty, animated, and gently aged, with drawing and transparent color supporting each other.
style_prompt_zh: 这种手工设色钢笔墨线技法让迅速勾出的轮廓在薄而不匀的淡彩之下依然可见。细密排线与破碎的方向性笔痕聚集在形体转入阴影的位置，轻染的开阔区域则保留纸面的温暖气息。色彩克制但富于变化：灰玫瑰色、低饱和青绿、橄榄色、暖灰与乳白覆盖在以黑褐线条为主的结构之上。不同的线条密度比平滑明暗过渡更能建立纵深。画面安排偏好在较清晰的竖向中心周围组织活泼的小笔痕群，因此繁复感成为生动节奏，而非混成一团噪声。边缘略显毛糙且有弹性，姿态以节省的笔触捕捉。宽泛的漫射光让淡彩保持透明，最深的重音则稳住构图。整体效果机智、活跃而带温和的旧感，线描与透明色彩相互支撑。
theme_en: A top-hatted gentleman watched by a crowd in a lively old street
theme_zh: 旧街上戴高礼帽的绅士受到人群注视
name: George Cruikshank
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
